name: South and North Cheshire Chamber of Commerce
what: The Employer Representative Body that wrote the Cheshire & Warrington Local Skills Improvement Plan.
why_contact: See the full LSIP and find out about local apprenticeships and employer events.

name: Cheshire and Warrington Combined Authority
what: The new regional authority, inaugurated in April 2026, responsible for growth, skills and transport across the sub-region.
why_contact: Find out about the region's Growth Plan and upcoming devolved skills funding.

name: Enterprise Cheshire and Warrington Growth Hub
what: The Growth Hub gives businesses and residents a single point of access to business and skills support.
why_contact: A good first stop for finding local training, funding and business contacts.

name: Cheshire and Warrington Careers Hub
what: The Careers & Enterprise Company's local hub, connecting schools and colleges with employers.
why_contact: Ask your school or college about Careers Hub events and employer talks.

name: University of Chester
what: The sub-region's main university, with strong nursing, business, science and engineering courses.
why_contact: Explore degree and higher apprenticeship routes in the region's priority sectors.

name: Reaseheath College
what: A specialist land-based college with major agri-tech, engineering and food technology facilities.
why_contact: Find out about courses in agriculture, engineering, agri-tech and food science.

name: Cheshire College South and West
what: A large FE college with campuses in Crewe, Chester and Ellesmere Port, offering T Levels and apprenticeships.
why_contact: Compare technical and vocational courses across engineering, health and business.

name: Warrington & Vale Royal College
what: A Centre of Technical Excellence offering apprenticeships and T Levels across manufacturing, construction and business.
why_contact: Look up courses and apprenticeships based in Warrington.

name: Cogent Skills
what: The employer-led skills body for life sciences, chemicals, nuclear and clean growth industries.
why_contact: See what skills and apprenticeships life sciences and clean energy employers are looking for.
